docs-site.tests/test_links.py:
from tools.links import collect, headings
from pathlib import Path


def test_headings():
    assert headings("# A\ntext\n## B") == ["A"]


def test_collect(tmp_path: Path):
    (tmp_path / "a.md").write_text("[x](b.md)\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert collect(tmp_path)[tmp_path / "a.md"] == ["b.md"]
